extraction.Name: J. Amelie Carpenter
extraction.Cancelled: Do not know if patent has been cancelled. Patent was mailed to Indian office by Superintendent.
extraction.Refused/Protested: I accepted it with protest, and not filed by me.
extraction.Recorded patent: Patent was mailed to Indian office by Superintendent
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Land has not been sold, or mortgaged. Land has not been mortgaged. Land has not been sold.
extraction.Occupation/Income: Supported by husband. No contributions for support from Government, State, or County.
extraction.NOTES: Legal resident of the Crow Creek Reservation, State of South Dakota; there is no dependent upon me for support; paid assessments have not been refunded; has not been defrauded of property; document sworn in County of Buffalo, State of South Dakota
